answer: A work-backed admission price with slow vesting is my chosen defense. Each new identity must lock a stake that is slashed if its answers are ever proven copied or sybil-linked, and the reward it earns stays in a short opal bond that unlocks only after many epochs of honest voting. A farmer spinning up a thousand identities must fund a thousand stakes plus an equal voyage of locked rewards before any profit returns; the capital cost per fake seat exceeds the marginal payout of one grade, so dilution stops being cheap. Clusters that vote together are detected and lose the violet deposit.
